meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: Claude 帮你走完插件发版流程：判断该升 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR，把八个清单文件里的版本号改齐，构建、提交、打标签、推送、建 GitHub Release、重新生成 CHANGELOG，最后把 npm 发布交给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你要求为插件升版本或做发布时触发。它会先判断这次改动属于 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR。

say.text: 帮我把版本升到 1.2.0，走完整发布流程
这次是新增功能，按 MINOR 升版本
say.note: 按 MINOR 递增版本号并重新生成 CHANGELOG

say.text: npm 发布我自己来，你先准备到交接那步
say.note: 它停在 npm 发布前，把命令和路径交给你

howto.what_en: Claude runs the release flow: picks PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, bumps the version in all eight manifests, builds, commits, tags, pushes, creates the GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, and leaves npm publish to you.
howto.when_en: When you ask to bump a plugin's version or cut a release. It first decides whether the change is PATCH, MINOR or MAJOR.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 1.2.0 and run the full release flow
say_en.note: Updates eight manifests, builds, tags, pushes, creates the release

say_en.text: This adds features, so bump MINOR
say_en.note: Increments the minor version and regenerates CHANGELOG

say_en.text: I'll run npm publish myself — prepare up to the handoff
say_en.note: It stops before npm and gives you the command and path
